answer: A workable design: weight rewards by the number of distinct jurisdictions that observed the work. Clustering on shared timing signatures exposes the operator. Because it works by forcing the attacker to duplicate sunk work across every clone, payouts to the cluster are redistributed to the honest peer pool. The wander of work and the island of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a voyage to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
